title: Convex-combination substitution bound on a ball
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every measurable h : ℝ^n → [0, ∞], every r > 0 and every t ∈ [0, 1], with B_r = ball(0, r) and Lebesgue measure |·|: ∫⁻_{x ∈ B_r} ∫⁻_{y ∈ B_r} h((1 − t)·y + t·x) dy dx ≤ 2^n · |B_r| · ∫⁻_{B_r} h (outer variable x, inner variable y; lintegrals in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable h → ∀ r t : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, h ((1 - t) • y + t • x) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * volume (ball (0 : Rn n) r) * ∫⁻ z in ball (0 : Rn n) r, h z
